User Story: As a CEO/admin, I want secure admin login so that only authorized staff can access business data.
Acceptance Criteria: MFA/OTP is supported; invalid credentials are rejected; sessions expire securely.

User Story: As a CEO, I want to see overall business KPIs so that I understand platform performance.
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard shows garages, customers, bookings, active jobs, completed jobs, revenue, cancellations, and payment failures.

User Story: As a CEO, I want to filter statistics by date, city, garage, and service so that I can compare performance.
Acceptance Criteria: Filters update all metrics and charts consistently.

User Story: As an admin, I want to view all garage owners so that I can monitor partner activity.
Acceptance Criteria: List supports search, status, city, ratings, bookings, jobs, and revenue.

User Story: As an admin, I want to view a garage profile and its operations so that I can identify issues.
Acceptance Criteria: Profile shows services, working hours, bookings, jobs, invoices, ratings, complaints, and recent activity.

User Story: As an admin, I want to activate, suspend, or verify a garage so that marketplace quality is controlled.
Acceptance Criteria: Status changes are permission-protected, audited, and reflected in customer search.

User Story: As an admin, I want to view customer accounts so that I can understand customer activity.
Acceptance Criteria: Customer profile shows vehicles, bookings, jobs, invoices, payments, reviews, and support tickets.

User Story: As an admin, I want to identify inactive or blocked customers so that I can manage account risks.
Acceptance Criteria: Search and filters show account status, last activity, failed payments, and support flags.

User Story: As an admin, I want to monitor all booking requests so that I can see demand and garage response performance.
Acceptance Criteria: Bookings show customer, garage, vehicle, service, date, status, and timestamps.

User Story: As an admin, I want to identify rejected, cancelled, and expired bookings so that I can investigate service problems.
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard provides reason, owner, time, and trend breakdowns.

User Story: As an admin, I want to monitor job cards created by garages so that I can see service progress.
Acceptance Criteria: Jobs show garage, customer, vehicle, status, timeline, services, parts, labour, and completion time.

User Story: As an admin, I want to identify delayed jobs and jobs waiting for parts so that I can intervene.
Acceptance Criteria: Filters and alerts show jobs exceeding configured time thresholds.

User Story: As a CEO, I want to view invoices, payments, refunds, and revenue so that I can monitor financial performance.
Acceptance Criteria: Reports show totals, trends, payment status, garage breakdown, taxes, discounts, and failures.

User Story: As an admin, I want to investigate a failed or disputed payment so that customer and garage issues can be resolved.
Acceptance Criteria: Payment attempts, gateway response, invoice, customer, and garage are linked.

User Story: As an admin, I want to view all platform notifications so that I know what customers and garages are receiving.
Acceptance Criteria: Notifications are searchable by recipient, type, booking, job, invoice, status, and timestamp.

User Story: As an admin, I want to send an operational announcement so that I can communicate with selected users or garages.
Acceptance Criteria: Audience, message, delivery status, and audit record are stored.

User Story: As an admin, I want to manage support tickets so that customer and garage problems are resolved.
Acceptance Criteria: Tickets can be assigned, prioritised, replied to, linked to records, and closed with an audit trail.

User Story: As a CEO, I want to export operational and financial reports so that I can share them with leadership.
Acceptance Criteria: Reports export with selected filters, date range, generated time, and source totals.

User Story: As an admin, I want an audit log of important actions so that platform changes are traceable.
Acceptance Criteria: Login, status changes, account actions, financial actions, and announcements record actor, time, IP/device, and result.

User Story: As a CEO, I want role-based access so that staff can access only the areas they are responsible for.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin roles and permissions restrict screens, data, exports, and actions.

User Story: As a CEO, I want to see how many job cards each garage owner created so that I can compare garage activity.
Acceptance Criteria: Report shows garage owner, garage, job cards created, date range, city, and ranking.

User Story: As a CEO, I want to see completed, in-progress, waiting-for-parts, ready, and cancelled jobs for each garage owner so that I can monitor operational performance.
Acceptance Criteria: Each garage owner has status counts and totals that reconcile with the job-card list.

User Story: As a CEO, I want to see the average job cards created per garage so that I can identify high- and low-performing partners.
Acceptance Criteria: Average is calculated for the selected date range and excludes inactive garages when configured.

User Story: As a CEO, I want to see each garage owner's booking-to-job conversion rate so that I can understand how effectively bookings become service work.
Acceptance Criteria: Formula and numerator/denominator are displayed: converted bookings divided by eligible accepted bookings.

User Story: As a CEO, I want to see each garage owner's average completion time so that I can identify service delays.
Acceptance Criteria: Average time from job-card creation to completion is shown with date-range filters and overdue flags.

User Story: As a CEO, I want to compare garage-owner revenue and average invoice amount so that I can understand commercial performance.
Acceptance Criteria: Revenue, paid invoices, failed payments, refunds, and average invoice value are shown per garage owner.

User Story: As a CEO, I want to filter garage-owner statistics by city, garage, service, and date range so that I can analyse a specific segment.
Acceptance Criteria: All cards, charts, rankings, and tables update consistently when filters change.

User Story: As a CEO, I want to export garage-owner performance statistics so that I can share the report with leadership.
Acceptance Criteria: Export includes selected filters, generated timestamp, source totals, and one row per garage owner.

User Story: As a CEO, I want to see customer and garage activity together so that I can understand the complete service funnel.
Acceptance Criteria: Activity view links customer booking, garage acceptance, job-card creation, job updates, invoice, payment, and review events.
